name: Kobuk Valley National Park
policyReason: Western Arctic National Parklands' compendium (which covers Kobuk Valley) closes no areas to pets; they must be leashed or restrained.
summary: No areas are closed to pets; keep them leashed or restrained at all times.

excerpts.quote: No designated areas.  Pets must be leashed or physically restrained at all times.

dogRules.text: Pets must be leashed or physically restrained at all times.
Sled dogs used for transportation may be left unattended up to 24 hours with shelter, food and water; other pets may not be left unattended.
Dispose of pet waste as the compendium directs.
